title: Remarkably Bright Creatures
author: Shelby Van Pelt
summary: A widow who cleans a small-town aquarium at night strikes up a friendship with a giant Pacific octopus. He has long watched everything that goes on in the building and has his own opinions about her missing son.
readIf: you want a gentle, funny story about loneliness in later life and an unusually clever animal.
skipIf: you want fast pacing or a sharp edge; this is a soft, steady and sentimental read.

pairings.reason: Another lonely older person gradually softened by the people and creatures who refuse to leave them alone.
Also a coastal small-town story with a strong sense of nature and a quiet mystery running underneath.
A cosy, funny cast of older characters who have more going on than anyone expects.
